about.title: Why We're Different
about.description: We joined the crypto revolution back in 2016, diving deep into Ethereum when smart contracts were still experimental. What started as weekend hackathons building analytics tools and small smart contracts evolved into something bigger. As hobbyists turned serious builders, we contributed to countless projects across the ecosystem, learning from every deployment and every bug. By 2021, we'd caught the attention of major players in DeFi - leading us to formalize Unforkable and take on the sophisticated infrastructure projects that define today's decentralized finance landscape. Our genuine love for decentralization and unwavering commitment to our clients has made us the silent partners behind many of the ecosystem's most innovative builders. We're not just service providers - we're crypto natives who've lived through every market cycle and emerged stronger, now expanding into AI automation and intelligent agent systems.
benefits: Crypto natives who've been building since ETH was $10
Unique commitment to our clients and projects
Networking opportunities with major accounts and projects
Built lending protocols, rebasing vaults, oracle systems, and automated trading
